name: Trello
summary: Trello is a card and board tool from Atlassian. The free plan allows 10 collaborators and 10 boards per Workspace. Standard costs $5 per user a month on annual billing, Premium costs $10 and adds the timeline view, and Enterprise costs $17.50.

facts.text: The free plan allows up to 10 collaborators per Workspace, 10 boards per Workspace, 250 Workspace command runs a month and 10MB per file.
Cards are unlimited on every plan, and assignee and due dates are included on Free and all paid plans.
The timeline view is a Premium feature, which Enterprise also includes.
SAML sign-in comes from Atlassian Guard, a separate subscription starting at $4 per user a month, and Enterprise includes it.
